END IF; ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='membership_access_sources' THEN r:=CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN OLD.id ELSE NEW.id END; IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM security_audit_events a WHERE a.source_id=r AND NOT membership_audit_valid(a.id)) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM membership_access_sources s WHERE s.id=r AND s.publication_state='published' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM security_audit_events a WHERE a.source_id=s.id AND a.event_type='membership_access_source_published' AND membership_audit_valid(a.id))) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'published source requires exact audit'; END IF; ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='membership_access_operations' THEN r:=CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN OLD.id ELSE NEW.id END; IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM security_audit_events a WHERE a.operation_id=r AND NOT membership_audit_valid(a.id)) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM membership_access_operations o WHERE o.id=r AND o.state='completed' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM security_audit_events a WHERE a.operation_id=o.id AND a.event_type='membership_access_operation_terminal' AND membership_audit_valid(a.id))) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'completed operation requires exact audit'; WITH op AS (SELECT id,mapping_id,transition_revision,state FROM membership_access_operations WHERE id=p_operation), expected(step_kind,mas_target_id,registry_snapshot_id,crypto_capability_id,room_target_id) AS (
  SELECT v.step_kind,m.id,NULL::uuid,NULL::uuid,NULL::uuid FROM op JOIN membership_access_mas_targets m ON (m.operation_id,m.mapping_id,m.transition_revision)=(op.id,op.mapping_id,op.transition_revision) CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT 'mas_lock'::text WHERE m.kind='bound' UNION ALL SELECT 'mas_finish_sessions' WHERE m.kind='bound' UNION ALL SELECT 'mas_prerequisite' WHERE m.kind='missing') v(step_kind)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'registry_prerequisite',NULL,r.id,NULL,NULL FROM op JOIN membership_access_registry_snapshots r ON (r.operation_id,r.mapping_id,r.transition_revision)=(op.id,op.mapping_id,op.transition_revision) WHERE r.kind='missing'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'room_ban',NULL,NULL,NULL,t.id FROM op JOIN membership_access_registry_snapshots r ON (r.operation_id,r.mapping_id,r.transition_revision)=(op.id,op.mapping_id,op.transition_revision) JOIN membership_access_room_targets t ON (t.registry_snapshot_id,t.operation_id,t.mapping_id,t.transition_revision)=(r.id,op.id,op.mapping_id,op.transition_revision) WHERE r.kind='complete'
  UNION ALL SELECT CASE c.kind WHEN 'supported' THEN 'crypto_gate' ELSE 'crypto_prerequisite' END,NULL,NULL,c.id,NULL FROM op JOIN membership_access_crypto_capabilities c ON (c.operation_id,c.mapping_id,c.transition_revision)=(op.id,op.mapping_id,op.transition_revision)
 ), actual AS (SELECT step_kind,mas_target_id,registry_snapshot_id,crypto_capability_id,room_target_id FROM membership_access_steps WHERE operation_id=p_operation)
 SELECT COALESCE((SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM membership_access_mas_targets WHERE operation_id=op.id)=1 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM membership_access_registry_snapshots WHERE operation_id=op.id)=1 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM membership_access_crypto_capabilities WHERE operation_id=op.id)=1 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM membership_access_room_targets WHERE operation_id=op.id)=(SELECT COALESCE(sum(expected_room_count) FILTER (WHERE kind='complete'),0) FROM membership_access_registry_snapshots WHERE operation_id=op.id) AND (SELECT count(*) FROM expected)=(SELECT count(*) FROM actual) AND NOT EXISTS((SELECT * FROM expected EXCEPT SELECT * FROM actual) UNION ALL (SELECT * FROM actual EXCEPT SELECT * FROM expected)) AND (op.state<>'completed' OR (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM membership_access_steps st WHERE st.operation_id=op.id AND st.state<>'succeeded') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM security_audit_events a WHERE a.operation_id=op.id AND a.event_type='membership_access_operation_terminal' AND a.outcome='success' AND a.reason='completed'))) FROM op),true)

BEGIN IF OLD.state='succeeded' AND (TG_OP='DELETE' OR ROW(NEW.id,NEW.operation_id,NEW.mapping_id,NEW.transition_revision,NEW.step_kind,NEW.state,NEW.mas_target_id,NEW.registry_snapshot_id,NEW.crypto_capability_id,NEW.room_target_id,NEW.attempt_count,NEW.next_attempt_at,NEW.lease_token,NEW.lease_generation,NEW.lease_owner,NEW.lease_expires_at,NEW.error_code,NEW.confirmed_at,NEW.evidence_fingerprint) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.id,OLD.operation_id,OLD.mapping_id,OLD.transition_revision,OLD.step_kind,OLD.state,OLD.mas_target_id,OLD.registry_snapshot_id,OLD.crypto_capability_id,OLD.room_target_id,OLD.attempt_count,OLD.next_attempt_at,OLD.lease_token,OLD.lease_generation,OLD.lease_owner,OLD.lease_expires_at,OLD.error_code,OLD.confirmed_at,OLD.evidence_fingerprint)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'succeeded step is immutable'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END

DECLARE v_now timestamptz:=clock_timestamp(); removed bigint:=0; affected bigint; BEGIN PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(8004); IF p_now IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(p_now) OR p_now>v_now THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid cleanup cutoff'; END IF; DELETE FROM interaction_csrf WHERE retained_until<=p_now; GET DIAGNOSTICS affected=ROW_COUNT; removed:=removed+affected; DELETE FROM authorization_contexts WHERE retained_until<=p_now; GET DIAGNOSTICS affected=ROW_COUNT; removed:=removed+affected; DELETE FROM provider_artifacts WHERE retained_until<=p_now; GET DIAGNOSTICS affected=ROW_COUNT; RETURN removed+affected; END
